subject: Request: Delegated No-PO Path for MicroProcure Pilot
messages:
From: Lina Ortega <lina@microprocure.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T13:07:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for no-PO / delegated billing path

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo — MicroProcure is excited to kick off a 3-month pilot with Redwood Inference. We're a small billing team and our procurement process uses consolidated monthly invoices rather than individual POs.

To move quickly, would Redwood consider a delegated no-PO path for this pilot (single monthly invoice, cap under $2k/month)? We can provide the vendor packet and W-9 now. Our accounting contact is accounts@microprocure.io.

Why this helps: our customers are startups and we keep billing consolidated to minimize card fees and admin. We understand corporate controls — happy to accept Net30 and provide liability/insurance.

Attached: microprocure_vendor_packet.pdf, W-9_MicroProcure.pdf

Let me know what else you need and who to loop in on your side.

Best,
Lina Ortega
Head of Operations
MicroProcure Inc.
attachments: microprocure_vendor_packet.pdf, W-9_MicroProcure.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lina Ortega <lina@microprocure.io>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for no-PO / delegated billing path

Thanks Lina — appreciate the packet. Looping in procurement (Laura) and finance (Priyom) to evaluate a provisional approach for the 3-month pilot. My suggested workflow:

1) Procurement confirms minimal evidence & control requirements for a temporary no-PO lane.
2) Finance confirms the invoicing/remit setup and a spend cap for the pilot.
3) If approved, we grant a 90-day delegated billing exception with monitoring and clear stop criteria.

Laura/Priyom — Lina attached the vendor packet + W-9. Lina, please also add any insurance certs and a point-of-contact for remittance.

Attached: delegation_rationale.docx

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

> Hi Sean,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo — MicroProcure is excited to kick off a 3-month pilot with Redwood Inference...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lina Ortega <lina@microprocure.io>
Date: 2026-12-10T09:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for no-PO / delegated billing path

Thanks Sean and Lina. Procurement is open to a provisional pathway for low-dollar pilots, provided controls are in place. For us to approve a temporary no-PO lane we need the following completed: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (we need legal name, EIN, remit address, invoicing contact).
- Certificate of insurance on file (commercial general liability, limits >= $1M).
- Confirmation that invoices will be consolidated monthly and sent to ar@redwood.ai with a line-item detail referencing our pilot deal id.
- Agreed monthly cap (we propose $2,000/month for initial trial) and auto-reversion to PO-required for any month exceeding that cap.
- Signed SOW or pilot addendum that includes a 30-day termination clause.

If the above are provided we can grant a 90-day delegation authority to the account exec (Sean) to approve invoices under the cap. We will run simple monitoring (sample invoice audit once per month).

I've attached the temporary_delegation_checklist.pdf for Lina to fill and return. Once procurement receives it, Priyom can finalize the remit instructions and finance sign-off.

Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: temporary_delegation_checklist.pdf

From: Lina Ortega <lina@microprocure.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T12:11:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for no-PO / delegated billing path

Thanks Laura — attaching the filled checklist and insurance cert. A few quick answers inline:

- Vendor onboarding form: attached (mp_invoicing_profile.pdf) — includes remit contact (accounts@microprocure.io) and EIN.
- Insurance: attached insurance_certificate.pdf (CGL limits $1M).
- Invoicing cadence: monthly consolidated invoice, line items for each pilot usage period; we can include the Redwood pilot id on each line.
- Cap: agreeable to $2,000/month and auto-reversion if exceeded.
- Term: fine with 30-day termination.

We can sign a short pilot addendum — we use DocuSign for signature. Please advise who will sign on Redwood's side for the delegation.

Attachments: mp_invoicing_profile.pdf, insurance_certificate.pdf, updated_W-9.pdf

Best,
Lina Ortega
attachments: mp_invoicing_profile.pdf, insurance_certificate.pdf, updated_W-9.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lina Ortega <lina@microprocure.io>
Date: 2026-12-11T16:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for no-PO / delegated billing path

All — finance has reviewed the submitted docs and procurement's checklist. We will provisionally approve a 90-day trial (start date = first invoice received after onboarding completes) under the following conditions:

1) Monthly cap: $2,000. Any single monthly invoice exceeding $2,000 must be routed to AP and will require a PO.
2) Invoices must be consolidated monthly and sent to ar@redwood.ai with line-item detail and the HubSpot Deal ID (HS-Deal-45678).
3) Payment terms: Net30 from invoice receipt; early-pay discounts are acceptable but must be explicitly stated on the invoice.
4) Redwood procurement will audit one invoice per month (sample invoices) and can revoke the delegation immediately if control gaps are found.
5) This is a provisional exception; after 90 days procurement & finance will reassess and either formalize the delegation (documented in vendor profile) or require standard PO process.

Lina — please confirm you will send the first invoice to ar@redwood.ai and include the Deal ID. Once we receive the first invoice we will mark the vendor as 'temporary no-PO' for the pilot in our ERP.

I'll attach a one-page provisional-exception-authority PDF that outlines the conditions for your records.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Manager, Revenue Operations & Finance Controls
Redwood Inference
attachments: provisional-exception-authority.pdf
